summary: The product moves off software versions that no longer receive Microsoft security fixes.

fixes.title: Moved to supported .NET 10 and PowerShell 7.6
fixes.text: Microsoft ended security fixes for the previous versions on 10 November 2026. Every job and page now runs on versions supported until November 2028.

fixes.title: Patched, slimmer sign-in page
fixes.text: The sign-in page moves to a smaller, patched base. Nothing changes in your directory, data, rights or settings, and the update installs like any other.
